thread:
Dana (CS): Hey team, quick sync for Aurora private cutover. Network peering and firewall rules are in, but customer reports no KMS-wrapped secrets are decrypting on their side and their SIEM isn't seeing audit events. They called this a blocker for go-live and want dates. Can we triage?
Lewis (SRE): On it. Running a packet capture to confirm flow to the Private agent. Initial glance shows DNS resolving to the wrong ENI (split-horizon issue). Might be the customer's Route53 inbound zone.
Priya (Security): KMS side: their infra team used a granular CMK policy but forgot the cross-account attestation for our service role. Need the role ARN from their team and I'll propose the minimal policy change.
Dana (CS): Got the ARN from Aurora infra: arn:aws:iam::123450987654:role/aurora-deploy-role. They're nervous about widening the key policy; asked for a mitigation plan and temporary timeline for fix.
Hassan (Platform): For Private agent we need kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Encrypt (for some envelope flows). We'll document exact permissions. Also note our agent requires the key's keyUsage=ENCRYPT_DECRYPT and key spec OK.
infra-bot: CI job passed: private-agent 2026.04.02-22 build succeeded
Lewis (SRE): Confirmed route issue: their inbound DNS resolves to a peered VPC ENI that's not associated with the latest agent. Requesting they flush resolver cache and update the inbound record to the new ENI IP. ETA from their infra: 45m.
Priya (Security): Drafting CMK policy change: will scope to CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555555555555:key/abcd-ef12-3456 and add Condition aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceVpc. Posting snippet to #eng-security in a minute.
Dana (CS): They're asking for written remediation timeline for their execs (renewal risk flagged). Can we commit to a target?
Hassan (Platform): If DNS fixed and CMK policy updated we can run a joint decrypt test and replay audit events within 2 hours after both changes. That gives a clear go/no-go window for the customer.
Lewis (SRE): Once DNS + CMK done I'll run an end-to-end smoke: decrypt, API call, and push 1k synthetic flow logs to their SIEM via syslog connector. I'll capture logs and timestamps so they can validate parser mapping.
Priya (Security): Also adding retention recommendation and the exact audit event types they should expect: KMS:Encrypt KMS:Decrypt KMS:GenerateDataKey VPC:FlowCreate App:AuthEvent. Will attach to the ticket.
Dana (CS): Action items: 1) Aurora infra updates DNS to new ENI (owner: Aurora infra) 2) Priya to post CMK policy with Condition and minimal principals (owner: Priya) 3) Lewis to run E2E smoke after both (owner: Lewis) 4) Hassan to publish Private agent permission checklist and timing (owner: Hassan) 5) Dana to send remediation timeline and renewal-watch note to account execs (owner: Dana). Target: joint smoke today 18:00 UTC.
infra-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0422-aurora-kms-logs (owner: customer-success)
Dana (CS): I'll keep the customer board updated and set renewal-watch until smoke passes. Please ping me immediately on any slip.
Lewis (SRE): Copy. Will post progress in 30m.
Priya (Security): :lock: Posting policy snippet now and will link docs.
Hassan (Platform): I'll prepare a short cost/throughput note for the Private run to share with Aurora finance for renewal context.
Dana (CS): Thanks all — closing loop for now, will reopen thread with smoke results.
